title: Five Ideas / Five Builds — free pilot
selection_rule: Participant ranks their ideas; THYLORA picks the one that fits the delivery scope and explains the choice in writing, including why the others were not chosen (Contribution Wake rejected_ideas).

exclusions: legal, medical, tax or financial advice
publishing to any live store or social account
handling participant passwords or account logins

rights.build_license: Participant receives a non-exclusive perpetual licence to the delivered build for their own use; any sale by either party of the build requires a separate written agreement.
rights.confidentiality: Ideas are visible only to the assigned builder and the Chairman under Role Access grants; never used to train or seed other offers without written consent.

paths: second build at a fixed price
revenue-share on a store product (separate agreement)

public_copy: Bring up to five ideas. We will build one of them with you, for free, within a fixed scope. You keep your idea. We show the work only if you say yes, and you can change your mind.
